purpose: Generated replacements for all thirteen illustrated UI glyphs in the Shoditsa skin; no layout changes.
processing: WebP encoding preserving original dimensions and alpha; no retouching, crop or redrawing.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production-ready illustrated icon for the Shoditsa app, on a genuinely transparent background. This is a single standalone icon, never a sheet, collection, scene, UI screenshot or logo.
Style: a polished playful app illustration that belongs to the supplied owned Shoditsa mascot. Match the confident near-black rounded outer contour, warm friendly forms, subtle hand-shaped asymmetry and flat pastel painted surfaces. Finished professional craft, very clean shapes. Simplify aggressively to stay instantly readable at 32px, with one clear silhouette and only 2-4 interior details. Composition: centered large object occupying about 82 percent of a square canvas, equally generous transparent outer margins, complete subject, no clipping. Strong smooth outline proportionate to tiny display size. No labels, text, letters, watermark, typography, Duolingo character or logo. No decorative sparkles unless explicitly part of the object.
